facts.text: I've had the cough for the last 12 hours.

facts.item: when the fever, chills and headache started
facts.text: The fever, chills and headache started three days after my gallbladder operation.
It's on the right side of my chest.

facts.item: chest pain: worse when breathing in
facts.text: It gets worse when I breathe in.
Apart from these complaints and what's related to my recent surgery, I haven't noticed anything else wrong.
I recently had open surgery to remove my gallbladder.

facts.item: low blood pressure after the operation
facts.text: After the operation my blood pressure dropped once; it got better with IV fluids.
I had an abdominal hysterectomy 16 years ago because of multiple fibroids in my uterus.
I've smoked a pack of cigarettes a day for 17 years.

findings.name: abdominal examination
findings.result: Inspection: healing surgical incision below the right ribcage; auscultation: normal bowel sounds; percussion: normal; palpation: soft and nontender.

findings.result: Infiltrates in the right lower lobe consistent with pneumonia.

f010: 'Reports discomfort' is vague (no site); kept as a general complaint.
f011: Meta phrase from the review of systems turned into a catch-all denial; it only covers things outside her current complaints and the surgery.
f015: '17-year history of smoking' is read as current smoking; the source does not say whether she has quit.

leakage.reason: The chest X-ray result names the gold diagnosis ('consistent with pneumonia'); kept because it is the radiology answer.

source_issues: Gold diagnosis text appears in Test_Results (chest X-ray; pool flag visible_gold_alias_partitions = test_results).
Demographics say 'obese', but no fragment mentions weight or obesity, so there is no patient fact for it.
The smoking history is repeated in Past_Medical_History and Social_History; merged into f015.
Review_of_Systems is a meta phrase ('No other abnormalities noted apart from...'); converted to a catch-all denial (f011).
notes: Fever and productive cough are both named in the chief complaint, so both open the case.
The onset 'three days after the cholecystectomy' covers fever, chills and headache, so it is a standalone fact (f006); the cough has its own 12-hour duration (f003).
Right-sided chest pain worse on inspiration is filed under the respiratory system (pleuritic pain).

extras.objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with fever, chills, headache, right-sided chest pain, and a productive cough following an abdominal surgery.
